findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head b1956a9a19abafcd794eb6b1612cd38f4b04fdfd, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant with documentTenant, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
